scope: Offline comparison of pinned Android DH request and current normal CallClient/ApkCallProbe entry points

additionalDirectCallSites.source: Pinned APK VoIPService DEX instructions. Offsets are method-relative DEX code units.
additionalDirectCallSites.interpretation: The direct-call request, acceptance and inspected early outgoing cleanup select the same native connection type as DH. These callsites establish the Android routing choice for these operations. Endpoint selection, transport confidentiality and live acceptance require separate evidence.

test.reference: Independent Python struct.pack with canonical TL string/bytes padding, synthetic Android UUID record

conclusion: The pinned DH constructor, field order and uncached synthetic request match. The normal Android CallClient and APK probe also emit the same source-matched HTTPS frame. The pinned official callsite selects native connection type64, so this HTTPS test does not reproduce its actual call transport.
limits: INVALID_CONSTRUCTOR establishes rejection of the tested HTTPS request only. It does not prove the native method or service call feature is unsupported.
Official Android uses the stored DH version when available; version0 requests the uncached configuration.
No new live request, credentials, session mutation, native connection or production implementation change was made.
